description: The municipality of Bari publishes AMTAB stops, routes and published GTFS information. The AMTAB service package explicitly lists stop and line tables and a GTFS archive for Bari public transport. A separate MUSICA publication describes AMTAB stops. The stop publications overlap in subject but retain distinct native identifiers; row and date equivalence are unverified. The GTFS archive was not opened, so current routes, service dates and operational completeness are unverified. Coverage is Bari, Italy. The group retains 2 separately identified native publications. The provider lists CSV, ZIP representations. Archive contents and data rows were not read. The native catalogue declares a Creative Commons Attribution licence without a version; file-use charges and download conditions are not established. Metadata timestamps do not prove observation dates or present operation. Accuracy, completeness and current availability of individual features remain unverified.
